label: DisasterReady India - Mobile Safe Route Navigation
title: DisasterReady India - Mobile Safe Route Navigation
prompt: Mobile Safe Evacuation Routing & Turn-by-Turn (P8 /safety/4): Interactive mobile route evaluation from Gandhi Chowk (N1) to Sonpur Shelter (N10) on foot. Shows Route Comparison: Recommended Route B (24 min, 2.1 km, Low Hazard) vs Route A (Shortest: 18 min, 1.4 km, High Hazard - Flooded underpass) and Route C (Alternative: 28 min, 2.4 km). Plain language explanation: "Recommended: Route B. It takes 6 minutes longer but avoids the flooded underpass and stays on higher ground." Factor breakdown bars (Travel time, Hazard exposure, Road status). Turn-by-turn landmark directions on a vertical route line: "1. Start at Gandhi Chowk near petrol pump", "2. Turn left at Hanuman Temple", "3. Ridge traverse along Hill Road", "4. Arrive Sonpur Relief Shelter". Action buttons: "Start Route B", "Share Route & Location", "Listen", "Report Road Hazard".
